callable_contract.api: FakeScript.api(name:str, arguments:dict) -> immutable RawReturn, or the exact preconstructed synthetic exception object. Consume exactly the next api step; wrong name/arguments/extra dispatch raises ScriptMismatch. No fallback/native dispatch.
callable_contract.checkpoint: A step optional before_projection is compared against a read-only test observer supplied by the future test harness BEFORE the fake result or clock is delivered. This checks registration before post-clock/throwing work. The fake script itself never implements ownership transitions.
callable_contract.clock: FakeScript.clock() -> scripted seconds from exact integer now_ns/1e9, or exact synthetic exception. Consume next clock step without creating/resetting an origin. Origin is fixture fiction, not a live owner token.
callable_contract.exhaustion: assert_exhausted requires every scripted step consumed; any extra API/clock/hook fails. Replay of fake scripts alone tests interchange/identity, not port conformance.
callable_contract.hook: FakeScript.hook(name:str) consumes the next copy_bytes/hash_update/log_append checkpoint and may raise. It is test fault injection, never an actual semantic checker or ready authority.

path_records: Exact{kind,path,utf16_units}. UTF16 units=len(path.encode(utf-16-le))/2, never Python character count. Astral tests and4096/4097-unit limits are explicit. CanonicalDriveRoot ancestors C:\ and D:\ are metadata-only; no leaves/scans/discovery from roots.

step_union.clock_semantics: now_ns is strictnonnegative int; no implicit sample. Every script starts with one fixture clock sample0. API before/after checks are separate scripted samples. Returned raw resource/count must appear in observer projection before its after-clock sample. No API step is allowed after hard300s.
step_union.raise_shape: null or exact{class,message}; classes SyntheticFailure,UnreturnedCall,KeyboardInterrupt,SystemExit,UnicodeError. Factory constructs each exception once; identity is checked by probes.
step_union.raw_semantics: value is exact signed/unsigned scalar per API (null only unexpectedNULL). BOOL returns are raw0/1 ints. Failed/unreturned ReadFile/WriteFile count is undefined, not zero observed bytes. Raw buffers may be retained even when undefined. No return object is a typed ownership acknowledgment.
